topic.title: Design Guidance for Single Core Turbo Thermal Enablement

body.p: To maximize the likelihood of achieving maximum frequency in single-core turbo scenarios, the designer should consider:
Use heat pipes and cold plates with low resistance values. ​
Air coolers may suffice for mobile SKUs but should be validated against expected workload profiles. ​
Ensure adequate airflow and chassis design to prevent heat buildup. ​
Avoid placing heat-sensitive components near the package. ​
For transient workloads (~5s), thermal inertia may allow maximum frequency even if the cooling solution is marginal. ​
For sustained workloads, the cooling solution must consistently maintain Tsensor < temperature limits.
